method: Purposive eight-PR sample from the coordinator's 47 unused merged PRs. Labels made from local first-parent merged diffs, catalog capabilities and canonical trigger contracts at 730d998 before any prediction on this sample. The same worker labels and implements; this is not an independent blind review or a random sample.
labelPolicy: Select changed behavior within the skill contract. Routine correctness tests inherit their domain; substantial accessibility automation, contract matrices, runner changes and operational diagnosis additionally need quality. PR verification prose alone is not release-witness scope. Skill maintenance selects cross-agent-skill-platform, not every domain named in skill documentation.

cases.selectionReason: Backend relation and paired migration, with historical proof-cycle references and host verification prose.

expected.rationale: Migration 0005 adds ordered article_authors with foreign keys and unique positions; ports and both repositories implement atomic replacement and ordered reads. Domain/migration tests preserve consistency; no new test strategy or reader rendering.

cases.selectionReason: Multiple genuine scopes in shared reader and direction contracts, with long historical and verification sections.

expected.rationale: contract.ts adds optional failure views and a validated frozen imageSizes map; ArticleBody forwards sizes into nested figures and galleries.
Adds eager-import graph guards, visitor/owner rendering tests and a contract matrix for fallbacks, invalid inputs, freezing and nested image sizes.
Creates reader failure boundaries and direction-specific presentation, keeps visitor fallbacks and static not-found rendering, and supplies responsive image hints.

New resolveErrorPresentation server action and lazy boundary enforce owner-only Lab presentation, exclude session/error details, and refuse visitor or stale resolution; visitor tests guard this new authorization boundary.

cases.selectionReason: Reader presentation and substantial accessibility/performance automation, with history of earlier APIs and routine checks.

expected.rationale: Adds forced-colour/keyboard axe checks, cold/warm first-view image inventories, selected-media byte budgets and viewport/DPR coverage.
Cinematic failure views, focus targets, print/forced-colour styling and eager first-row images change reader presentation. Existing direction hooks are consumed, not redefined.

cases.selectionReason: Dependency security fix mentioning a historical ADR and CI verification without a new architecture decision.

expected.rationale: Updates Vite from 8.1.4 to 8.1.6 in package.json and lockfile for an advisory and refreshes three runtime digests; no new test runner or stack design.

cases.selectionReason: Test infrastructure only; backend service names in the runner do not imply backend data work.

expected.rationale: Moves Docker test service ports below the ephemeral range, adds pre-start availability probes and a matrix for cleanup, permission errors and startup races.

cases.selectionReason: Backend transaction safety plus operational diagnosis; explicit earlier-work and host-check sections.

expected.rationale: Moves object storage upload/verification outside idle-limited transactions; publishes only verified originals and retains idempotent recovery after uncertain commits.
Adds classified session-limit failures with stable SQLSTATE logging and a runbook separating transient failures from configuration refusals, including bounded lock recovery.
New handled error response and logging deliberately expose only fixed messages and allowed SQLSTATE codes, retaining the raw database error as an internal cause; tests guard private error details.

cases.selectionReason: Skill maintenance containing numerous neighboring domain names and references to earlier reviews.

expected.rationale: Only canonical skill descriptions and code-map references change: handoffs, redirect documentation and CI evidence wording. No runtime backend, SEO or release implementation changes.

cases.selectionReason: Reader retry accessibility and systematic real-boundary regression coverage, with explicit follow-up and review history.

expected.rationale: Adds real Next ErrorBoundaryHandler tests across all directions, failed/successful retries, delayed Lab resolution and user focus movement.
Restores main focus after failed retries, cancels restoration after reader focus movement and preserves first-render/successful-retry behavior.
